title: Instagram Profile Scraper - Bio, Followers & Stats
description: Collect public Instagram profile metadata and statistics with bounded HTTP sessions and proxy rotation.

usernames.title: Instagram Usernames or Profile URLs
usernames.description: Enter Instagram usernames (without @) or full profile URLs. Multiple entries supported.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Residential proxy is the reliable default because Instagram commonly limits datacenter traffic. A failed lookup is retried once with a fresh HTTP session.
